hypothesis: pre-entry exit-feasibility simulation: veto entries whose estimated exit slippage exceeds a calibrated threshold

method.costs: replay.net_pnl realistic fees+slippage; 3x slippage stress via cost_multiplier=3
method.estimator: constant-product avg impact = 100 * position_usd / (liquidity_usd/2 + position_usd), max with 15m-volume bound
method.split: chronological 47 IS / 24 OOS closes (71 matched; 3 unmatched closes excluded)

note: a veto that cannot fire is not a filter. exit-feasibility screening would only matter at position sizes or liquidity floors far outside this bot's current operating range.
reject_reasons: max estimated impact 0.1697% is two orders of magnitude below the lowest tested threshold (10%); every threshold retains every trade
per-trade edge over baseline is $0 in IS and $0 in OOS: no IS edge exists to retain, so the 60% OOS-retention gate is moot
stressed OOS (-$58.50) identical to baseline stressed OOS: no improvement under 3x slippage
structural cause: ~$7 positions vs $15k+ minimum entry liquidity; exit impact is negligible by construction, so the veto can never bite
